title: Charm
tagline: charm is a neuro-enabled blockcoin for crosschain magic combining the elements of salt, sulfur and mercury into a coin
description: Use alchemical primitive construction (body soul and spirit) to explore the uses of a coin, that enables cross network bridging and swaps using the cosine similarity* of a networks cognitive data as a function of price, and when not available use the sunrise as a function of price
how_its_made: The project uses sequence wallets, indexer and relayer on the different networks of optimism and goerli base. It uses a brain computer interface to pick up on the cognitive flow of a community, and aggregate in a backend for token price signing to be used by users. The bridge of token takes all of 7-20 seconds.
